segments.text: Ipoh, a city where nature, food, and rich cultural heritage come together.
Its scenic landscapes, warm hospitality, and authentic local flavours continue to draw visitors from near and far, year after year.
Yet, when the day's journey comes to an end, where do visitors go?
And what will give them a reason to stay in Ipoh a little longer?
Today, a new destination is taking shape in Tambun, Ipoh.
A place designed to bring the city's experiences together.
Urban Forest.
From theme stays and relaxing getaways to immersive spaces filled with stories and character, the journey becomes more than just a stop along the way.
We are having a world-class hospitality brand to operate the accommodation suites.
And in Ipoh, no experience is complete without food.
From the familiar flavours of Ipoh to a more diverse culinary experience, Urban Forest aims to keep the city alive from day into night.
From local delicacies to international cuisine.
Dining, entertainment, lights, and nighttime experiences, creating something for everyone and memories for every generation.
Extending the celebration of Ipoh city day by MBI, bringing the spirits of Ipoh beyond a single day.
So, what makes Urban Forest different?
We don't wait until completion and hope it works.
We plan how it will operate before we build it.
Before construction is completed, the commercial mix, hospitality, and attractions are already planned as one connected ecosystem along with traffic flow and operating strategy.
Because the tenant mix is secured early, operators can prepare before completion reducing the wait between handover and rental income.
For the investor, the return structure is established upfront with a 5.5% return, a long-term lease and contractual step-ups for greater income visibility.
First, professional hospitality and tour management continuously brings visitors into the ecosystem turning accommodation, tourism and commercial activity into one connected destination.
Second, established international and local brands create immediate recognition giving people stronger reasons to visit, spend and return.
Third, 128 eateries are curated without duplication creating greater variety while reducing internal competition.
TKB continues actively managing the destination after opening.
Urban Forest is planned to perform, managed to sustain and structured for long-term returns.
Urban Forest, where your investment is built to keep working.
